title: U.S. House · Ohio's 8th District
area: Western Ohio, including Butler and Miami counties and parts of Hamilton and Clark counties (Hamilton, Fairfield, West Chester Township, Troy).

context.text: Incumbent Warren Davidson (R) advanced unopposed from the May 5, 2026 Republican primary. Vanessa Enoch (D) defeated Madaris Grant in the Democratic primary, 74.5%-25.5%. Enoch previously ran against Davidson in the 2022 and 2024 general elections, losing both.

positions.summary: His official site's pro-life page says life begins at conception and that the right to life is a freedom government has a duty to protect.
positions.quote: Life begins at conception, and the right to life is the first freedom government has a duty to protect.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Financial Services and the Committee on Foreign Affairs in the 119th Congress (2025-2026).

Chaired the Financial Services Subcommittee on Housing and Insurance and served as vice chairman of the Subcommittee on Digital Assets, Financial Technology and Inclusion in the 118th Congress (2023-2024).

positions.summary: In a March 2026 campaign post on the conflict with Iran, she says the power to declare war belongs to Congress and that sustained military action requires congressional authorization.
positions.quote: The United States Constitution is clear: the power to declare war belongs to Congress.

positions.summary: In an August 2024 campaign post she says she supports reproductive rights for women and will fight for access to reproductive care.
positions.quote: I will fight every day for a woman’s right to safe, accessible, and affordable reproductive care.

positions.summary: Her campaign issues page lists raising the minimum wage among policies to make costs more affordable.
Her campaign issues page says home costs have outpaced incomes because of zoning laws and other policies, and calls for rewriting land-use rules and investing in mixed-income developments.
positions.quote: We can change course by rewriting land‑use rules, investing in mixed-income developments

researchNotes: Davidson has not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey, and his official House website issues pages and Enoch's campaign site did not yield verbatim, current issue statements at the fetched URLs, so priorities and positions are omitted rather than inferred. Federal key votes and FEC finance totals are added separately. Enoch's biography relies on Ballotpedia; no news profile of her career was found.
